comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — bonjour-dv.ru's fixed blue cookie-consent banner covers the product page content; it is hidden by adding bonjour-dv.ru to the existing shared rule `##.fixed.bottom-0` at AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt line 171 (under the comment `! ##.fixed.bottom-0`), which apply_rule verified with the banner gone and page integrity intact. ## Rule `bonjour-dv.ru##.fixed.bottom-0` ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie-consent notice annoyance, which the repository's Annoyances/Cookie Notices filter covers; it is not a paywall, not an anti-adblock wall, not self-promotion and not a scam page, so no policy rule closes it. The fix hides the site's own cookie banner only, the same treatment the existing shared `##.fixed.bottom-0` rule already gives 199 other domains; no advertising content is affected. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/2fdc51144fd57bf6c8815a2de98032c84a71ff80/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) By adding the domain to the existing rule on [line 171](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/2fdc51144fd57bf6c8815a2de98032c84a71ff80/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L171). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/45919797518 Automated analysis against filters at `2fdc511`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.
